title: Noroña Rejects TEEM Ruling, Announces Appeal to Federal Electoral Court
detail: Senator Gerardo Fernández Noroña publicly rejected the Michoacán Electoral Tribunal's July 6 gender-violence ruling, calling it 'arbitrary' and demanding the magistrates publicly justify their legal reasoning. He argued his remarks about Uruapan Mayor Grecia Quiroz — calling her 'irresponsible' and 'fascist' and questioning her gubernatorial ambitions — amounted to legitimate political debate rather than gender-based harassment, and contended a male politician would not have faced sanction for similar language. Noroña announced he would appeal the resolution to federal electoral authorities, arguing it damages his reputation and restricts his political participation.

media.caption: Noroña rejects the TEEM sanction and announces he will appeal
